definition: Initial therapy for a condition typically with best efficacy/safety balance
when_used: At diagnosis or initial presentation of disease

definition: Therapy after failure or intolerance of first-line
when_used: After inadequate response or adverse effects to 1st line

definition: Subsequent therapy after two prior lines
Therapy given after primary treatment to reduce risk of recurrence
decision_criteria: Pathologic risk factors; tumor stage; genomic markers

definition: Therapy given before primary treatment to improve outcomes
Long-term therapy to sustain remission or prevent relapse
Last-line aggressive therapy for refractory disease
decision_criteria: Performance status; organ function; patient wishes

definition: Therapy to prevent occurrence of disease or complications
Therapy aimed at symptom relief rather than cure
decision_criteria: Symptoms; quality of life; goals of care

definition: Intensive initial therapy to achieve rapid control
column7: Disease severity; need for rapid response

definition: Therapy after induction to deepen response
Therapy given based on biomarker without waiting for disease
when_used: When risk marker indicates high likelihood of disease

definition: Changing from one drug to another within same line due to intolerance or lack of efficacy
Adding another agent to existing regimen
decision_criteria: Synergy; complementary mechanisms; safety of combination
